text:
alex: quick q — users hitting `Invalid basic auth` when they put API keys with a colon into env vars on Windows. repro shows `curl -u $REDWOOD_API_KEY:` failing in pwsh but works on mac. anyone seen similar?

sam: do they use `-u` or `Authorization` header? `-u` treats the value as `user:pass` and pwsh sometimes strips quotes.

alex: example from customer: `setx REDWOOD_API_KEY "sk:abcd1234"` then `curl -u $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY: https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` -> 401. same key works with `-H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"`.
maria: yeah pwsh will remove surrounding quotes in some contexts and `:` can be interpreted oddly. Recommend avoiding `-u` for API keys. prefer `Authorization: Bearer`. Also SDKs should accept raw keys, not require `basic` encoding.
devops-bot: GitHub Actions note: secrets are masked in logs (****), and actions runners sometimes add a trailing newline if you echo into files — watch for `
`.
sam: small SDK checklist: trim whitespace/newlines; reject keys containing spaces and provide clear error; when using Basic, always do `base64(key + ':')` not `base64(key)`; on reconnects re-send `Authorization` header.
alex: re: reconnects — we've seen streaming reconnects drop auth header and then connection gets 401 during streaming retries. is that expected?
leo: streaming behavior: current client reuses an existing socket when possible, but on fallback it may re-open without applying header middleware on the reconnect path. that's a bug. will add an extra header push during reconnects.
maria: PR created with two small fixes: trim env var, add Authorization reattach on reconnect. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 (requesting @sam @leo review).
sam: will review today. quick nit: add unit tests for `process.env` scenarios — pwsh, cmd, gha, docker.
alex: thanks — also can we add a short note in quickstart about `curl -u` caveat and prefer `-H "Authorization: Bearer"`? saves support time.
maria: will add doc patch after PR merges. :thumbsup:
leo: filed a follow-up issue to audit other streaming clients for the same reconnect bug.
alex: great, thanks everyone — ping me on the PR if anything else pops up.
